```{r}
# Check vcalc covariances, record order and arm IDs.
# Record_ID should uniquely identify each comparison. Check Arm_ID conflicts across experiments within each study.
audit_chlorophyll_V <- function(dat, V, analysis_label) {
  arms <- bind_rows(
    transmute(dat, Study_ID, Experiment_ID, Arm_ID = Treatment_Arm_ID),
    transmute(dat, Study_ID, Experiment_ID, Arm_ID = Control_Arm_ID)
  )
  conflicts <- arms |>
    group_by(Study_ID, Arm_ID) |>
    summarise(Experiments = n_distinct(Experiment_ID), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(Experiments > 1)
  if (nrow(conflicts) > 0) print(conflicts, n = Inf, width = Inf)

  # Construct expected_V independently from arm IDs and sample sizes to check the vcalc results.
  same_scope <- outer(dat$Study_ID, dat$Study_ID, "==") &
    outer(dat$Experiment_ID, dat$Experiment_ID, "==")
  same_arm <- function(a, b) outer(dat[[a]], dat[[b]], "==") & same_scope
  w_t <- 1 / sqrt(dat$T_n)
  w_c <- 1 / sqrt(dat$C_n)
  contrast_scale <- sqrt(1 / dat$T_n + 1 / dat$C_n)
  expected_R <- (
    same_arm("Treatment_Arm_ID", "Treatment_Arm_ID") * tcrossprod(w_t) +
      same_arm("Control_Arm_ID", "Control_Arm_ID") * tcrossprod(w_c) -
      same_arm("Treatment_Arm_ID", "Control_Arm_ID") * outer(w_t, w_c) -
      same_arm("Control_Arm_ID", "Treatment_Arm_ID") * outer(w_c, w_t)
  ) / tcrossprod(contrast_scale)
  expected_V <- expected_R * sqrt(outer(dat$vi, dat$vi))
  tolerance <- 1e-10 * sqrt(outer(dat$vi, dat$vi))
  nonzero <- abs(V) > tolerance
  expected_nonzero <- abs(expected_V) > tolerance
  upper <- upper.tri(V)

  result <- tibble(
    Analysis = analysis_label, Effect_sizes = nrow(dat),
    Record_ID_unique = !anyNA(dat$Record_ID) && anyDuplicated(dat$Record_ID) == 0,
    Comparisons_unique = nrow(distinct(
      dat, Study_ID, Experiment_ID, Treatment_Arm_ID, Control_Arm_ID, Endpoint_day
    )) == nrow(dat),
    Arm_ID_conflicts = nrow(conflicts),
    Diagonal_matches_vi = all(abs(diag(V) - dat$vi) <= 1e-10 * dat$vi),
    Row_order_matches = identical(rownames(V), as.character(dat$Record_ID)) &&
      identical(colnames(V), as.character(dat$Record_ID)),
    Expected_shared_pairs = sum(expected_nonzero[upper]),
    Nonzero_pairs = sum(nonzero[upper]),
    Unexpected_pairs = sum(upper & nonzero & !expected_nonzero),
    Missing_shared_pairs = sum(upper & !nonzero & expected_nonzero),
    V_values_match = all(abs(V - expected_V) <= tolerance)
  ) |>
    mutate(Passed = Record_ID_unique & Comparisons_unique & Arm_ID_conflicts == 0 &
      Diagonal_matches_vi & Row_order_matches & V_values_match &
      Unexpected_pairs == 0 & Missing_shared_pairs == 0)
  result
}


# Use the same diagnostic rules for both model types. Retain calculable estimates and distinguish fitting failures from diagnostic warnings.
# Record differences between optimizers in likelihood, effect size, intervals and variances. Use numerical tolerances to assess agreement.
review_chlorophyll_fit <- function(model, check_model, dat, V, notes,
                                   variance_ci_ok, hessian_ok = NA) {
  compare_ok <- !is.null(check_model)
  ll_difference <- g_difference <- variance_difference <- ci_difference <- NA_real_
  if (compare_ok) {
    ll_difference <- abs(as.numeric(logLik(model)) - as.numeric(logLik(check_model)))
    g_difference <- abs(as.numeric(coef(model) - coef(check_model)))
    variance_difference <- max(abs(model$sigma2 - check_model$sigma2) /
      (1 + abs(model$sigma2)))
    ci_difference <- max(abs(c(model$ci.lb, model$ci.ub) -
      c(check_model$ci.lb, check_model$ci.ub)))
  }
  optimizer_ok <- isTRUE(compare_ok && ll_difference < 1e-5 &&
    variance_difference < 1e-3 && g_difference < 1e-4)
  model_V_ok <- model$k == nrow(dat) &&
    identical(as.character(model$data$Record_ID), as.character(dat$Record_ID)) &&
    identical(as.numeric(model$yi), as.numeric(dat$yi)) &&
    isTRUE(all.equal(as.matrix(model$V), as.matrix(V),
      tolerance = 1e-10, check.attributes = FALSE))
  convergence_code <- model$opt.res$convergence
  converged <- is.null(convergence_code) || isTRUE(convergence_code == 0)
  core_ok <- all(is.finite(c(coef(model), model$ci.lb, model$ci.ub,
    model$pval, model$sigma2, model$ddf[1]))) && isTRUE(model$ddf[1] > 0)

  if (!converged) notes <- c(notes, "Primary optimizer did not report convergence")
  if (!model_V_ok) notes <- c(notes, "Model data/order/V differs from input")
  if (!core_ok) notes <- c(notes, "Core inference is incomplete or non-finite")
  if (!optimizer_ok) notes <- c(notes, "Optimizer comparison outside strict tolerance; inspect differences")
  if (!isTRUE(variance_ci_ok)) notes <- c(notes, "Variance profile CI requires review")
  if (!is.na(hessian_ok) && !hessian_ok) notes <- c(notes, "Variance Hessian requires review")

  # A boundary estimate alone is not a failure. Warnings do not clear Hedges' g or calculable CIs.
  boundary <- any(model$sigma2 < 1e-8)
  needs_review <- length(notes) > 0
  status <- if (!converged) {
    "Convergence failure; estimates provisional"
  } else if (needs_review) {
    "Review required; estimates provisional"
  } else if (boundary) {
    "Caution: variance at boundary"
  } else "Numerical checks passed"

  values <- tibble(
    Hedges_g = as.numeric(coef(model)), CI_lower = model$ci.lb,
    CI_upper = model$ci.ub, p_value = model$pval,
    Converged = converged, Core_inference_finite = core_ok,
    Model_V_matches_input = model_V_ok, Optimizers_agree = optimizer_ok,
    LogLik_difference = ll_difference, Hedges_g_difference = g_difference,
    Max_relative_variance_difference = variance_difference,
    Max_CI_difference = ci_difference, Boundary_estimate = boundary,
    Needs_review = needs_review, Status = status
  )
  # Estimates with Needs_review=TRUE are for review only, not final thesis conclusions or plotted pooled effects.
  list(values = values, notes = notes, stable = !needs_review && core_ok && model_V_ok)
}


# 2. Shared model function: use the same method for the primary analysis and the sensitivity analysis excluding S05 ------------
# V describes correlation in sampling errors. The two random variances describe true-effect differences between studies and within studies.
# The group-ID and sample-size method in vcalc approximates shared-control covariance. It is not an exact SMD covariance formula.
# This covariance approximation applies to one response time point per study. Repeated measurements need an additional correlation structure.
# Method reference: https://wviechtb.github.io/metafor/reference/vcalc.html
#           https://wviechtb.github.io/metafor/reference/rma.mv.html
fit_chlorophyll_model <- function(dat, analysis_label) {
  notes <- character()
  V <- NULL
  v_check <- NULL

  # Capture warnings and errors from model fitting and covariance checks. Return an empty model if fitting fails.
  capture_step <- function(expr, step) {
    tryCatch(
      withCallingHandlers(expr, warning = function(w) {
        notes <<- c(notes, paste0(step, " warning: ", conditionMessage(w)))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }),
      error = function(e) {
        notes <<- c(notes, paste0(step, " error: ", conditionMessage(e)))
        NULL
      }
    )
  }

  result <- tibble(
    Model_structure = "Study + comparison random intercepts",
    Analysis = analysis_label,
    Studies = n_distinct(dat$Study_ID), Effect_sizes = nrow(dat),
    Status = "Model failed", Converged = FALSE, Needs_review = TRUE,
    V_check_passed = FALSE, Arm_ID_conflicts = NA_integer_, Hedges_g = NA_real_,
    CI_lower = NA_real_, CI_upper = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
    Test_df = NA_real_,
    Sigma2_between_studies = NA_real_, Sigma2_within_study = NA_real_,
    Between_variance_CI_lower = NA_real_, Between_variance_CI_upper = NA_real_,
    Within_variance_CI_lower = NA_real_, Within_variance_CI_upper = NA_real_,
    QE = NA_real_, QE_df = NA_real_, QE_p_value = NA_real_,
    Optimizers_agree = FALSE, Variance_Hessian_ok = FALSE,
    Variance_profiles_ok = FALSE, Boundary_estimate = NA,
    Diagnostics = ""
  )

  finish <- function(model = NULL, stable = FALSE) {
    result$Diagnostics <- paste(unique(notes), collapse = " | ")
    list(model = model, stable = stable, summary = result, V = V, V_check = v_check)
  }

  # Treatment is the first group and Control is the second, consistent with the direction of the existing yi.
  # Represent arm correlations with the full V. Keep a non-positive-definite matrix as an input issue.
  V <- capture_step(metafor::vcalc(
    vi, cluster = Study_ID,
    grp1 = Treatment_Arm_ID, grp2 = Control_Arm_ID,
    w1 = T_n, w2 = C_n, data = dat,
    checkpd = TRUE, nearpd = FALSE
  ), "Sampling covariance")
  if (is.null(V)) return(finish())
  # Label V rows and columns with Record_ID to check data order.
  dimnames(V) <- list(as.character(dat$Record_ID), as.character(dat$Record_ID))
  v_check <- capture_step(audit_chlorophyll_V(
    dat, V, paste("Multilevel", analysis_label, sep = " / ")
  ), "V audit")
  result$V_check_passed <- !is.null(v_check) && isTRUE(v_check$Passed)
  if (!is.null(v_check)) result$Arm_ID_conflicts <- v_check$Arm_ID_conflicts
  if (!result$V_check_passed) {
    notes <- c(notes, "V audit failed; do not fit until input is checked")
    result$Status <- "Input check failed"
    return(finish())
  }
  if (is.null(capture_step(chol(V), "Positive-definite V"))) return(finish())

  model <- capture_step(metafor::rma.mv(
    yi, V = V, random = ~ 1 | Study_ID/Record_ID,
    data = dat, method = "REML", test = "t", dfs = "contain",
    cvvc = TRUE
  ), "Primary fit")
  if (is.null(model)) return(finish())
  if (model$k != nrow(dat)) notes <- c(notes, "Model omitted input comparisons")

  # Cross-check the fit with another optimizer using the same random structure and V.
  check_model <- capture_step(metafor::rma.mv(
    yi, V = V, random = ~ 1 | Study_ID/Record_ID,
    data = dat, method = "REML", test = "t", dfs = "contain",
    control = list(optimizer = "BFGS")
  ), "Optimizer check")

  # Use profile-likelihood intervals for variance components to assess uncertainty near boundaries.
  variance_ci <- capture_step(do.call(rbind, lapply(1:2, function(j) {
    stats::confint(model, sigma2 = j)$random[1, ]
  })), "Variance profiles")

  result$Sigma2_between_studies <- model$sigma2[1]
  result$Sigma2_within_study <- model$sigma2[2]
  result$Boundary_estimate <- any(model$sigma2 < 1e-8)
  result$QE <- model$QE
  result$QE_df <- model$k - model$p
  result$QE_p_value <- model$QEp
  result$Test_df <- model$ddf[1]

  # Retain variance estimates and diagnostics. Mark the pooled estimate for review when there are diagnostic warnings.
  result$Variance_Hessian_ok <- isTRUE(is.matrix(model$vvc) &&
    identical(dim(model$vvc), c(2L, 2L)) && all(is.finite(model$vvc)) &&
    min(eigen(model$vvc, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values) > 0 &&
    kappa(model$vvc, exact = TRUE) < 1e8)
  result$Variance_profiles_ok <- isTRUE(!is.null(variance_ci) &&
    all(is.finite(variance_ci)) &&
    all(variance_ci[, "ci.ub"] > variance_ci[, "ci.lb"]))
  if (!is.null(variance_ci)) {
    result$Between_variance_CI_lower <- variance_ci[1, "ci.lb"]
    result$Between_variance_CI_upper <- variance_ci[1, "ci.ub"]
    result$Within_variance_CI_lower <- variance_ci[2, "ci.lb"]
    result$Within_variance_CI_upper <- variance_ci[2, "ci.ub"]
  }

  checked <- review_chlorophyll_fit(
    model, check_model, dat, V, notes,
    variance_ci_ok = result$Variance_profiles_ok,
    hessian_ok = result$Variance_Hessian_ok
  )
  for (column in names(checked$values)) result[[column]] <- checked$values[[column]]
  notes <- checked$notes
  finish(model, stable = checked$stable)
}

# 3. Keep all comparisons in the primary analysis. Exclude S05 as a whole only in the sensitivity analysis. ------------------------
chlorophyll_main <- fit_chlorophyll_model(chlorophyll_data, "All studies")
chlorophyll_without_s05 <- fit_chlorophyll_model(
  filter(chlorophyll_data, Study_ID != "S05"), "Excluding S05"
)

# Give a compact V check. Count each nonzero comparison pair once in the upper triangle and do not print the full matrix.
chlorophyll_v_check <- bind_rows(
  chlorophyll_main$V_check, chlorophyll_without_s05$V_check
)
print(chlorophyll_v_check, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Report the two heterogeneity variances and the generalised Q test. Do not use a single-level I² formula.
# Use t inference with containment df. Do not call this a Knapp-Hartung correction.
chlorophyll_model_summary <- bind_rows(
  chlorophyll_main$summary, chlorophyll_without_s05$summary
)
print(chlorophyll_model_summary, n = Inf, width = Inf)
if (!chlorophyll_main$stable || !chlorophyll_without_s05$stable) {
  message("Some models need review. Their estimates have been retained. Results with Needs_review=TRUE must not be used for final thesis conclusions.")
}
write.csv(
  chlorophyll_model_summary, "outputs/Chlorophyll_a_model_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE, na = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)
```

#### Chlorophyll-a — Study-intercept sensitivity analysis

```{r}
#| label: chlorophyll-study-intercept-sensitivity

# 1. Use the primary-analysis data and their sampling covariance matrix ----------------------------
# Compare all studies with the data excluding S05 in the sensitivity analysis.
# The simpler model has only a study random intercept. The full V still represents sampling correlation.
# Take V from the primary analysis's vcalc result and keep its row and column order aligned with the data.
chlorophyll_sensitivity_data <- chlorophyll_data
chlorophyll_sensitivity_V <- chlorophyll_main$V

if (is.null(chlorophyll_sensitivity_data) ||
    is.null(chlorophyll_sensitivity_V) ||
    nrow(chlorophyll_sensitivity_data) != nrow(chlorophyll_sensitivity_V)) {
  stop("The completed Chlorophyll-a primary-model object, its data and V must be available first.")
}


# 2. Shared simpler model: Study_ID random intercept, REML and small-sample t inference --------------
# Use the same model and diagnostic tolerances for both datasets.
# Variance may validly be 0, so use profile-likelihood intervals to check uncertainty near the boundary.
# Zero variance is a valid boundary. A boundary or Hessian diagnostic alone cannot establish model failure.
# Method reference: https://wviechtb.github.io/metafor/reference/confint.rma.html
fit_chlorophyll_study_intercept <- function(dat, V, analysis_label) {
  issues <- character()
  v_check <- NULL
  capture_step <- function(expr, step) {
    tryCatch(
      withCallingHandlers(expr, warning = function(w) {
        issues <<- c(issues, paste0(step, " warning: ", conditionMessage(w)))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }),
      error = function(e) {
        issues <<- c(issues, paste0(step, " error: ", conditionMessage(e)))
        NULL
      }
    )
  }

  result <- tibble(
    Model_structure = "Study random intercept",
    Analysis = analysis_label,
    Studies = n_distinct(dat$Study_ID), Effect_sizes = nrow(dat),
    Hedges_g = NA_real_, CI_lower = NA_real_, CI_upper = NA_real_,
    p_value = NA_real_, Test_df = NA_real_,
    Sigma2_study = NA_real_, Variance_CI_lower = NA_real_,
    Variance_CI_upper = NA_real_, Boundary_estimate = NA,
    Converged = FALSE, Optimizers_agree = FALSE, Variance_CI_ok = FALSE,
    QE = NA_real_, QE_df = NA_real_, QE_p_value = NA_real_,
    Status = "Model failed", Needs_review = TRUE, V_check_passed = FALSE,
    Arm_ID_conflicts = NA_integer_, Diagnostics = ""
  )

  finish <- function(model = NULL) {
    result$Diagnostics <- paste(unique(issues), collapse = " | ")
    list(model = model, summary = result, V_check = v_check)
  }

  v_check <- capture_step(audit_chlorophyll_V(
    dat, V, paste("Study intercept", analysis_label, sep = " / ")
  ), "V audit")
  result$V_check_passed <- !is.null(v_check) && isTRUE(v_check$Passed)
  if (!is.null(v_check)) result$Arm_ID_conflicts <- v_check$Arm_ID_conflicts
  if (!result$V_check_passed) {
    issues <- c(issues, "V audit failed; do not fit until input is checked")
    result$Status <- "Input check failed"
    return(finish())
  }

  # Capture optimization failures and retain the full V for shared-control correlation.
  model <- capture_step(metafor::rma.mv(
    yi, V = V, random = ~ 1 | Study_ID, data = dat,
    method = "REML", test = "t", dfs = "contain", level = 95
  ), "Primary fit")
  if (is.null(model)) return(finish())
  result$Converged <- TRUE
  if (model$k != nrow(dat)) issues <- c(issues, "Model omitted input comparisons")

  check_model <- capture_step(metafor::rma.mv(
    yi, V = V, random = ~ 1 | Study_ID, data = dat,
    method = "REML", test = "t", dfs = "contain", level = 95,
    control = list(optimizer = "BFGS")
  ), "Optimizer check")

  variance_ci <- capture_step(
    stats::confint(model, sigma2 = 1, level = 95)$random[1, ],
    "Variance profile CI"
  )
  result$Sigma2_study <- model$sigma2[1]
  result$Boundary_estimate <- model$sigma2[1] < 1e-8
  result$Test_df <- model$ddf[1]
  result$QE <- model$QE
  result$QE_df <- model$k - model$p
  result$QE_p_value <- model$QEp

  result$Variance_CI_ok <- isTRUE(!is.null(variance_ci) &&
    all(is.finite(variance_ci)) &&
    variance_ci["ci.ub"] > variance_ci["ci.lb"] &&
    variance_ci["ci.lb"] <= model$sigma2[1] + 1e-6 &&
    variance_ci["ci.ub"] >= model$sigma2[1] - 1e-6)
  if (!is.null(variance_ci)) {
    result$Variance_CI_lower <- variance_ci["ci.lb"]
    result$Variance_CI_upper <- variance_ci["ci.ub"]
  }

  checked <- review_chlorophyll_fit(
    model, check_model, dat, V, issues, variance_ci_ok = result$Variance_CI_ok
  )
  for (column in names(checked$values)) result[[column]] <- checked$values[[column]]
  issues <- checked$notes
  finish(model)
}

# 3. Compare all data with the data excluding S05 using the same simpler model -------------------------
# When excluding S05, subset both the rows and columns of V.
chlorophyll_keep_without_s05 <- chlorophyll_sensitivity_data$Study_ID != "S05"

chlorophyll_simple_all <- fit_chlorophyll_study_intercept(
  chlorophyll_sensitivity_data, chlorophyll_sensitivity_V, "All studies"
)
chlorophyll_simple_without_s05 <- fit_chlorophyll_study_intercept(
  chlorophyll_sensitivity_data[chlorophyll_keep_without_s05, , drop = FALSE],
  chlorophyll_sensitivity_V[
    chlorophyll_keep_without_s05, chlorophyll_keep_without_s05, drop = FALSE
  ],
  "Excluding S05"
)


# 4. Summarise the simpler-model sensitivity results ------------------------------------
# The simpler model assumes no additional comparison-level true heterogeneity within studies. This is a sensitivity assumption.
# Passing numerical checks does not make small-sample estimates precise. Interpret them with the variance intervals and Q test.
chlorophyll_sensitivity_summary <- bind_rows(
  chlorophyll_simple_all$summary, chlorophyll_simple_without_s05$summary
)
print(chlorophyll_sensitivity_summary, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Show the two-level and study-intercept models side by side, each with all studies and with S05 excluded.
chlorophyll_comparison <- bind_rows(chlorophyll_model_summary, chlorophyll_sensitivity_summary) |>
  mutate(Study_variance = coalesce(Sigma2_between_studies, Sigma2_study)) |>
  select(Model_structure, Analysis, Studies, Effect_sizes, Hedges_g, CI_lower, CI_upper,
    Study_variance, Comparison_variance = Sigma2_within_study, Status, Needs_review)
print(chlorophyll_comparison, n = Inf, width = Inf)
chlorophyll_v_check <- bind_rows(
  chlorophyll_main$V_check, chlorophyll_without_s05$V_check,
  chlorophyll_simple_all$V_check, chlorophyll_simple_without_s05$V_check
)
print(chlorophyll_v_check, n = Inf, width = Inf)
if (any(chlorophyll_sensitivity_summary$Needs_review)) {
  message("Some simpler models need review. Estimates are retained, but results with Needs_review=TRUE must not be used for final conclusions.")
}
write.csv(
  chlorophyll_sensitivity_summary, "outputs/Chlorophyll_a_sensitivity_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE, na = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)
```

### Biofilm biomass and growth

```{r}
#| label: biofilm-biomass-growth-models

# 1. Read the calculated biofilm mass and growth effect sizes ------------------------------
# Use the CSV exported by the effect-size calculation step, containing existing yi, vi and extraction information.
# Keep original Response names and all extraction information. For S01, include only grazer-excluded responses.
biofilm_mass_data <- read.csv(
  "outputs/Effect_size_calculated.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
) |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  filter(
    (Study_ID %in% c("S14", "S15", "S16", "S21") & Response_reported == "Dry weight") |
      (Study_ID == "S03" & Response_reported %in% c("AFDW", "AFDM")) |
      (Study_ID == "S01" & Response_reported == "Biofilm growth rate - grazer excluded")
  ) |>
  arrange(Study_ID, Experiment_ID, Treatment_Arm_ID, Record_ID)

# S01 may have missing Endpoint_day values. Retain SDs approximated from fitted-model 95% CIs.
# Keep S16 dry-weight units as reported, including the note about inconsistent units and the original values.
biofilm_mass_counts <- biofilm_mass_data |>
  group_by(Response_reported, Study_ID) |>
  summarise(
    Effect_sizes = n(),
    Control_groups = n_distinct(Experiment_ID, Control_Arm_ID),
    Shared_control = Effect_sizes > Control_groups, .groups = "drop"
  )
print(biofilm_mass_counts, n = Inf, width = Inf)
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(biofilm_mass_data$Record_ID), !anyDuplicated(biofilm_mass_data$Record_ID),
  all(is.finite(biofilm_mass_data$yi)),
  all(is.finite(biofilm_mass_data$vi) & biofilm_mass_data$vi > 0),
  all(is.finite(biofilm_mass_data$C_n) & biofilm_mass_data$C_n >= 2),
  all(is.finite(biofilm_mass_data$T_n) & biofilm_mass_data$T_n >= 2)
)

# 2. Construct an approximate sampling covariance V for shared experimental groups --------------------------------
# V handles sampling correlation from shared controls. Two-level random effects describe true-effect heterogeneity and cannot replace V.
# Approximate correlation using actual Arm_IDs and group sample sizes. This is not an exact SMD covariance formula.
# Each study contributes one response. Identify group correlations using the original arm IDs.
# Do not fill in S01 times or add a repeated-measures correlation assumption.
# S01 fitted-model estimates may have extra correlation not represented by V. Assess its influence by excluding S01.
biofilm_mass_V <- metafor::vcalc(
  vi, cluster = Study_ID,
  grp1 = Treatment_Arm_ID, grp2 = Control_Arm_ID,
  w1 = T_n, w2 = C_n, data = biofilm_mass_data,
  checkpd = TRUE, nearpd = FALSE
)
dimnames(biofilm_mass_V) <- rep(list(as.character(biofilm_mass_data$Record_ID)), 2)

# Check the diagonal of V, its row and column order, and whether nonzero covariances correspond to shared experimental groups.
same_scope <- outer(biofilm_mass_data$Study_ID, biofilm_mass_data$Study_ID, "==") &
  outer(biofilm_mass_data$Experiment_ID, biofilm_mass_data$Experiment_ID, "==")
shared_arm <- same_scope & (
  outer(biofilm_mass_data$Treatment_Arm_ID, biofilm_mass_data$Treatment_Arm_ID, "==") |
    outer(biofilm_mass_data$Control_Arm_ID, biofilm_mass_data$Control_Arm_ID, "==") |
    outer(biofilm_mass_data$Treatment_Arm_ID, biofilm_mass_data$Control_Arm_ID, "==") |
    outer(biofilm_mass_data$Control_Arm_ID, biofilm_mass_data$Treatment_Arm_ID, "==")
)
upper <- upper.tri(biofilm_mass_V)
nonzero <- abs(biofilm_mass_V) > 1e-10 * sqrt(outer(biofilm_mass_data$vi, biofilm_mass_data$vi))
biofilm_mass_V_check <- tibble::tibble(
  Diagonal_matches_vi = all(abs(diag(biofilm_mass_V) - biofilm_mass_data$vi) <=
    1e-10 * biofilm_mass_data$vi),
  Row_order_matches = identical(rownames(biofilm_mass_V), as.character(biofilm_mass_data$Record_ID)) &
    identical(colnames(biofilm_mass_V), as.character(biofilm_mass_data$Record_ID)),
  Shared_pairs_expected = sum(shared_arm[upper]),
  Nonzero_pairs = sum(nonzero[upper]),
  Shared_arm_pattern_matches = all(nonzero[upper] == shared_arm[upper]),
  Symmetric = isSymmetric(as.matrix(biofilm_mass_V))
)
print(biofilm_mass_V_check, n = Inf, width = Inf)
stopifnot(with(biofilm_mass_V_check,
  Diagonal_matches_vi & Row_order_matches & Shared_arm_pattern_matches & Symmetric))
invisible(chol(biofilm_mass_V))  # Stop the analysis if V is not positive definite. Keep the original covariance structure.

# 3. Use the same two-level REML model and diagnostics for the primary and sensitivity analyses ------------------
# Keep study- and comparison-level random intercepts. Both variances may still be imprecisely estimated with few studies.
# Record variance boundaries. Zero variance alone is not a failure. Hessian calculations or variance-profile intervals are not required.
fit_biofilm_mass <- function(dat, V, analysis_label) {
  notes <- character()
  run_fit <- function(control, optimizer_label) {
    tryCatch(
      withCallingHandlers(
        metafor::rma.mv(
          yi, V = V, random = ~ 1 | Study_ID/Record_ID, data = dat,
          method = "REML", test = "t", dfs = "contain", control = control
        ),
        warning = function(w) {
          notes <<- c(notes, paste(optimizer_label, "warning:", conditionMessage(w)))
          invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
        }
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        notes <<- c(notes, paste(optimizer_label, "error:", conditionMessage(e)))
        NULL
      }
    )
  }
  result <- tibble::tibble(
    Analysis = analysis_label, Studies = n_distinct(dat$Study_ID), Effect_sizes = nrow(dat),
    Responses = paste(unique(dat$Response_reported), collapse = "; "),
    Hedges_g = NA_real_, CI_lower = NA_real_, CI_upper = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
    Test_df = NA_real_, Sigma2_between_studies = NA_real_, Sigma2_within_study = NA_real_,
    Primary_convergence_code = NA_integer_, Check_convergence_code = NA_integer_,
    LogLik_difference = NA_real_, Hedges_g_difference = NA_real_,
    Max_CI_difference = NA_real_, Max_relative_variance_difference = NA_real_,
    Optimizers_agree = FALSE, Boundary_estimate = NA, Model_V_matches_input = FALSE,
    Status = "Model failed", Needs_review = TRUE, Diagnostics = ""
  )
  model <- run_fit(list(
    optimizer = "nlminb", iter.max = 2000, eval.max = 4000, rel.tol = 1e-10
  ), "nlminb")
  if (is.null(model)) {
    result$Diagnostics <- paste(unique(notes), collapse = " | ")
    return(list(model = NULL, summary = result))
  }

  # Cross-check the REML fit with BFGS using the same data, V and random structure.
  check_model <- run_fit(list(
    optimizer = "BFGS", maxit = 2000, reltol = 1e-10,
    sigma2.init = pmax(model$sigma2, 1e-6)
  ), "BFGS")
  result$Hedges_g <- as.numeric(coef(model))
  result$CI_lower <- model$ci.lb
  result$CI_upper <- model$ci.ub
  result$p_value <- model$pval
  result$Test_df <- model$ddf[1]
  result$Sigma2_between_studies <- model$sigma2[1]
  result$Sigma2_within_study <- model$sigma2[2]
  result$Boundary_estimate <- any(model$sigma2 < 1e-8)
  if (!is.null(model$opt.res$convergence)) {
    result$Primary_convergence_code <- model$opt.res$convergence
  }
  result$Model_V_matches_input <- model$k == nrow(dat) &&
    identical(as.character(model$data$Record_ID), as.character(dat$Record_ID)) &&
    isTRUE(all.equal(as.matrix(model$V), as.matrix(V), check.attributes = FALSE, tolerance = 1e-10))

  if (!is.null(check_model)) {
    if (!is.null(check_model$opt.res$convergence)) {
      result$Check_convergence_code <- check_model$opt.res$convergence
    }
    result$LogLik_difference <- abs(as.numeric(logLik(model) - logLik(check_model)))
    result$Hedges_g_difference <- abs(as.numeric(coef(model) - coef(check_model)))
    result$Max_CI_difference <- max(abs(c(model$ci.lb, model$ci.ub) -
      c(check_model$ci.lb, check_model$ci.ub)))
    result$Max_relative_variance_difference <- max(abs(model$sigma2 - check_model$sigma2) /
      (1 + pmax(abs(model$sigma2), abs(check_model$sigma2))))
  }

  # Assess optimizer agreement using likelihood, effect-size, interval and relative variance differences, and report these differences.
  # The 0.001 tolerance for g and CIs is finer than the two-decimal precision used in figures. It is not a statistical significance threshold.
  result$Optimizers_agree <- isTRUE(
    result$Primary_convergence_code == 0 & result$Check_convergence_code == 0 &
      result$LogLik_difference <= 1e-3 & result$Hedges_g_difference <= 1e-3 &
      result$Max_CI_difference <= 1e-3 & result$Max_relative_variance_difference <= 1e-3
  )
  core_ok <- all(is.finite(c(result$Hedges_g, result$CI_lower, result$CI_upper,
    result$p_value, result$Test_df, model$sigma2))) && result$Test_df > 0 &&
    all(model$sigma2 >= 0) && result$CI_lower <= result$Hedges_g &&
    result$CI_upper >= result$Hedges_g
  if (!core_ok) notes <- c(notes, "Core inference incomplete or invalid")
  if (!result$Model_V_matches_input) notes <- c(notes, "Model data/order/V differs from input")
  if (!result$Optimizers_agree) notes <- c(notes, "Optimizer agreement requires review")
  result$Needs_review <- length(notes) > 0
  result$Status <- if (result$Needs_review) {
    "Review required; estimates provisional"
  } else if (result$Boundary_estimate) {
    "Caution: variance at boundary; few studies"
  } else "Numerical checks passed; few studies"
  result$Diagnostics <- paste(unique(notes), collapse = " | ")
  list(model = model, summary = result)
}

# 4. Include S01 in the primary analysis. For sensitivity analysis, exclude S01 and subset both rows and columns of V. -----------
# Excluding S01 changes both the indicator scope and the estimation method. Differences cannot be attributed to only one of these changes.
biofilm_mass_main <- fit_biofilm_mass(
  biofilm_mass_data, biofilm_mass_V, "Main: DW + AFDW/AFDM + growth"
)
keep_without_s01 <- biofilm_mass_data$Study_ID != "S01"
biofilm_mass_without_s01 <- fit_biofilm_mass(
  biofilm_mass_data[keep_without_s01, ],
  biofilm_mass_V[keep_without_s01, keep_without_s01, drop = FALSE],
  "Sensitivity: DW + AFDW/AFDM; excluding S01"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: biofilm-biomass-growth-summary

# QE is the generalised Q test of residual heterogeneity based on the model's V. Its degrees of freedom are k − p.
# Take the statistic and P value from QE and QEp in the corresponding fitted object. Keep NA when there is no pooled model.
extract_model_QE <- function(result) {
  fit <- result$model
  dplyr::mutate(result$summary,
    QE = if (is.null(fit)) NA_real_ else fit$QE,
    QE_df = if (is.null(fit)) NA_real_ else fit$k - fit$p,
    QE_p_value = if (is.null(fit)) NA_real_ else fit$QEp
  )
}

biofilm_mass_model_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(
  list(biofilm_mass_main, biofilm_mass_without_s01), extract_model_QE
))
print(biofilm_mass_model_summary, n = Inf, width = Inf)
if (any(biofilm_mass_model_summary$Needs_review)) {
  message("Some models need review. Calculable estimates are retained but are not yet used for final thesis conclusions.")
}
write.csv(
  biofilm_mass_model_summary, "outputs/Biofilm_biomass_growth_model_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE, na = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)
# With only 5–6 independent studies, numerical convergence does not remove uncertainty from the small sample or approximate V.
```

### EPS-related responses

```{r}
#| label: eps-data-models

# 1. Read EPS response records and calculated effect sizes --------------------------------
# Use the same inclusion rules as the effect-size calculation. Statistics and notes must agree between Excel and CSV.
# Limit the input to actual data columns A:R to avoid blank columns that only have formatting on the right of the sheet.
eps_source <- readxl::read_excel(
  "../03_Extraction_Data/data table - thesis.xlsx", sheet = "Effect_size_data",
  range = readxl::cell_cols("A:R"), col_types = "text"
) |>
  filter(grepl("EPS|extracellular polymer", Response_reported, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
  distinct()
eps_data <- read.csv(
  "outputs/Effect_size_calculated.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
) |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  filter(grepl("EPS|extracellular polymer", Response_reported, ignore.case = TRUE))

# Check statistics and Note for matching comparisons in Excel and CSV.
eps_keys <- c("Study_ID", "Experiment_ID", "Control_Arm_ID", "Treatment_Arm_ID", "Response_reported")
eps_stat_cols <- c("C_mean", "C_SD", "C_n", "T_mean", "T_SD", "T_n")
eps_current <- left_join(
  eps_data, select(eps_source, all_of(c(eps_keys, eps_stat_cols)), Note),
  by = eps_keys, suffix = c("", "_Excel")
)
if (nrow(eps_current) != nrow(eps_data)) {
  stop("EPS comparison IDs are not unique. Check Excel and the effect-size table first.")
}
for (column in eps_stat_cols) {
  current <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(eps_current[[paste0(column, "_Excel")]]))
  if (any(!is.finite(current) |
      abs(eps_current[[column]] - current) > 1e-8 * (1 + abs(current)))) {
    stop("EPS data have changed. Run the existing Hedges' g calculation chunk first to update the effect-size CSV.")
  }
}
if (any(coalesce(eps_current$Note, "") != coalesce(eps_current$Note_Excel, ""))) {
  stop("EPS extraction notes have changed. Update the effect-size table first and retain the latest inclusion decisions.")
}

# 2. Define EPS groups and retain original response names ----------------------------------
# Keep Total carbon EPS separate from Total EPS. Do not infer Total EPS by adding its components.
eps_groups <- c("Total EPS", "EPS polysaccharides", "EPS proteins", "Total carbon EPS")
eps_group_map <- c(
  "EPS" = "Total EPS", "EPS polysaccharides" = "EPS polysaccharides",
  "EPS protein" = "EPS proteins", "Total carbon EPS" = "Total carbon EPS"
)
eps_source <- mutate(eps_source, EPS_group = unname(eps_group_map[Response_reported]))
eps_data <- eps_data |>
  mutate(EPS_group = unname(eps_group_map[Response_reported])) |>
  arrange(match(EPS_group, eps_groups), Study_ID, Experiment_ID, Treatment_Arm_ID, Record_ID)
if (anyNA(eps_data$EPS_group)) {
  print(distinct(filter(eps_data, is.na(EPS_group)), Study_ID, Response_reported),
    n = Inf, width = Inf)
  stop("A quantitative EPS response has no confirmed classification. Confirm it first. Responses are not combined automatically.")
}

# The inventory also keeps original EPS indicators that were not included. Count available studies by unique Study_ID.
eps_classification <- eps_source |>
  group_by(EPS_group, Response_reported) |>
  summarise(
    Study_IDs_recorded = paste(sort(unique(Study_ID)), collapse = ", "),
    Studies_recorded = n_distinct(Study_ID), Records_recorded = n(), .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    eps_data |>
      group_by(Response_reported) |>
      summarise(
        Study_IDs_available = paste(sort(unique(Study_ID)), collapse = ", "),
        Studies_available = n_distinct(Study_ID), Effect_sizes_available = n(), .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "Response_reported"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    EPS_group = coalesce(EPS_group, "Qualitative EPS distribution; not pooled"),
    Study_IDs_available = coalesce(Study_IDs_available, ""),
    across(c(Studies_available, Effect_sizes_available), ~ coalesce(.x, 0L))
  ) |>
  arrange(match(EPS_group, eps_groups), Response_reported)
print(eps_classification, n = Inf, width = Inf)
# EPS component/spatial distribution is qualitative evidence and is not included in the meta-analysis.
# Carbohydrates (AWCD) measures substrate use, not EPS polysaccharide content.

# 3. Model EPS groups separately without pooling effects across components ------------------------
# Use fit_biofilm_mass() for fitting and diagnostics, and audit_chlorophyll_V() for shared-control covariance checks.
# These functions are defined in the biofilm mass and growth and chlorophyll analyses, respectively, and are dependencies of this section.
# EPS models use this section's data and V, not fitted results for other indicators.
# A study can contribute to several EPS groups. Do not treat the pooled group results as independent between-group comparisons.
analyse_eps_group <- function(group_name) {
  dat <- filter(eps_data, EPS_group == group_name)
  result <- list(model = NULL, data = dat, V = NULL, V_check = NULL,
    summary = tibble::tibble(
      Analysis = group_name, Studies = n_distinct(dat$Study_ID), Effect_sizes = nrow(dat),
      Responses = paste(unique(dat$Response_reported), collapse = "; "),
      Hedges_g = NA_real_, CI_lower = NA_real_, CI_upper = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
      Sigma2_between_studies = NA_real_, Sigma2_within_study = NA_real_,
      Status = if (nrow(dat) == 0) "No eligible quantitative data" else "One study; individual effects only",
      Needs_review = FALSE, Pool_shown = FALSE, Diagnostics = ""
    ))
  # Do not fit a cross-study pooled model for a group with fewer than two independent studies.
  if (n_distinct(dat$Study_ID) < 2) return(result)

  # V handles sampling correlation from shared controls. Random effects handle true heterogeneity between studies and between comparisons.
  # Fit groups separately. Each study contributes one response within a group, so no cross-component correlation is specified.
  tryCatch({
    V <- metafor::vcalc(
      vi, cluster = Study_ID, grp1 = Treatment_Arm_ID, grp2 = Control_Arm_ID,
      w1 = T_n, w2 = C_n, data = dat, checkpd = TRUE, nearpd = FALSE
    )
    dimnames(V) <- rep(list(as.character(dat$Record_ID)), 2)
    # Check shared experimental groups, vi, row and column order, and group-ID conflicts.
    v_check <- audit_chlorophyll_V(dat, V, group_name)
    if (!isTRUE(v_check$Passed)) stop("Shared-arm V audit failed")
    invisible(chol(V))
    fitted <- fit_biofilm_mass(dat, V, group_name)
    fitted$data <- dat
    fitted$V <- V
    fitted$V_check <- v_check
    fitted$summary$Pool_shown <- !is.null(fitted$model) && !isTRUE(fitted$summary$Needs_review)
    fitted
  }, error = function(e) {
    result$summary$Status <- "V/model check failed; individual effects only"
    result$summary$Needs_review <- TRUE
    result$summary$Diagnostics <- conditionMessage(e)
    result
  })
}
eps_models <- setNames(lapply(eps_groups, analyse_eps_group), eps_groups)
```

```{r}
# p_value tests whether the overall mean effect is 0. QE_p_value tests residual heterogeneity. Keep both fields separately.
# Total EPS and Total carbon EPS have no pooled models. Keep all three heterogeneity fields as NA.
eps_model_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(eps_models, extract_model_QE))
figure8_V_check <- bind_rows(lapply(eps_models, function(x) x$V_check))
```

### Prokaryotic alpha diversity

Chao1 and Shannon are analysed separately as exploratory responses. Each has 10 calculated effect sizes from S02, S03 and S15. For each indicator, S15 contributes 6 treatment comparisons sharing one control. Simpson has 6 eligible comparisons from only one study, so it is neither pooled across studies nor plotted separately.

Each response uses shared-control sampling covariance approximated from arm IDs and sample sizes. Both models use study- and comparison-level random intercepts, REML, and t inference with containment df. No cross-response correlation coefficient is specified. Fits are checked with two optimizers. A zero-variance boundary alone does not count as failure. There are only 3 independent studies, so passing numerical checks still does not guarantee precise estimates.

Chao1 and Shannon each produce primary-model results and diagnostics. Their pooled results are used in Figure 8 and Table 1.

```{r}
#| label: alpha-diversity-data-model-function
# 1. Read calculated prokaryotic Chao1 and Shannon effect sizes -------------------------
library(dplyr)
library(metafor)
alpha_diversity_data <- read.csv("outputs/Effect_size_calculated.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM") |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  filter(Response_reported %in% c("Prokaryotic Chao1 richness", "Prokaryotic Shannon diversity"),
    !Study_ID %in% c("S06", "S18")) |>
  arrange(Response_reported, Study_ID, Experiment_ID, Treatment_Arm_ID, Record_ID)
stopifnot(nrow(alpha_diversity_data) > 0, !anyDuplicated(alpha_diversity_data$Record_ID),
  all(is.finite(alpha_diversity_data$yi)), all(is.finite(alpha_diversity_data$vi) & alpha_diversity_data$vi > 0),
  all(is.finite(alpha_diversity_data$CI_lower)), all(is.finite(alpha_diversity_data$CI_upper)),
  all(is.finite(alpha_diversity_data$C_n) & alpha_diversity_data$C_n >= 2),
  all(is.finite(alpha_diversity_data$T_n) & alpha_diversity_data$T_n >= 2))

# Check shared controls for each response. Multiple treatment comparisons do not count as multiple studies.
alpha_diversity_controls <- alpha_diversity_data |>
  group_by(Response_reported, Study_ID, Experiment_ID, Control_Arm_ID) |>
  summarise(Comparisons = n(), Treatments = n_distinct(Treatment_Arm_ID), .groups = "drop")
alpha_diversity_study_counts <- alpha_diversity_controls |>
  group_by(Response_reported, Study_ID) |>
  summarise(Effect_sizes = sum(Comparisons), Shared_control_groups = sum(Treatments > 1),
    Shared_control_IDs = paste(Control_Arm_ID[Treatments > 1], collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop")
print(alpha_diversity_study_counts, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# 2. Fit Chao1 and Shannon separately using the same model and diagnostic methods ----------------
# Each model contains one response. Approximate sampling covariance using arm IDs and sample sizes.
# Represent sampling correlation from shared controls; Study_ID/Record_ID describes two-level true heterogeneity.
# Use original arm IDs to identify shared groups. Do not additionally assume independence between experiments.
# Method: https://wviechtb.github.io/metafor/reference/vcalc.html
#       https://wviechtb.github.io/metafor/reference/rma.mv.html
fit_alpha_diversity_model <- function(dat, response_name) {
  notes <- character()
  model <- V <- NULL
  controls <- dat |>
    group_by(Study_ID, Experiment_ID, Control_Arm_ID) |>
    summarise(Treatments = n_distinct(Treatment_Arm_ID), .groups = "drop")
  result <- tibble::tibble(
    Analysis = response_name, Studies = n_distinct(dat$Study_ID), Effect_sizes = nrow(dat),
    Exploratory = TRUE, Shared_control_groups = sum(controls$Treatments > 1),
    Hedges_g = NA_real_, CI_lower = NA_real_, CI_upper = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
    Test_df = NA_real_, Sigma2_between_studies = NA_real_, Sigma2_within_study = NA_real_,
    QE = NA_real_, QE_df = NA_integer_, QE_p_value = NA_real_,
    Primary_convergence_code = NA_integer_, Check_convergence_code = NA_integer_,
    LogLik_difference = NA_real_, Hedges_g_difference = NA_real_,
    Max_CI_difference = NA_real_, Max_relative_variance_difference = NA_real_,
    Optimizers_agree = FALSE, Boundary_estimate = NA, Model_V_matches_input = FALSE,
    Needs_review = TRUE, Pool_shown = FALSE, Status = "Model not fitted", Diagnostics = ""
  )
  if (result$Studies < 2) {
    result$Status <- "Insufficient independent studies; not pooled"
    return(list(data = dat, V = V, model = model, summary = result))
  }
  run_fit <- function(control, label) {
    withCallingHandlers(metafor::rma.mv(yi, V = V,
      random = ~ 1 | Study_ID/Record_ID, data = dat,
      method = "REML", test = "t", dfs = "contain", control = control),
      warning = function(w) {
        notes <<- c(notes, paste(label, "warning:", conditionMessage(w)))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      })
  }
  tryCatch({
    V <- metafor::vcalc(vi, cluster = Study_ID,
      grp1 = Treatment_Arm_ID, grp2 = Control_Arm_ID, w1 = T_n, w2 = C_n,
      data = dat, checkpd = TRUE, nearpd = FALSE)
    dimnames(V) <- rep(list(as.character(dat$Record_ID)), 2)
    stopifnot(isSymmetric(as.matrix(V)), all(abs(diag(V) - dat$vi) <= 1e-10 * dat$vi))
    invisible(chol(V))  # Stop fitting if V is not positive definite. Keep the original covariance structure.
    model <- run_fit(list(optimizer = "nlminb", iter.max = 2000,
      eval.max = 4000, rel.tol = 1e-10), "nlminb")
    # Cross-check the fit with BFGS using the same data, V and random structure.
    check <- tryCatch(run_fit(list(optimizer = "BFGS", maxit = 2000, reltol = 1e-10,
      sigma2.init = pmax(model$sigma2, 1e-6)), "BFGS"), error = function(e) {
        notes <<- c(notes, paste("BFGS error:", conditionMessage(e)))
        NULL
      })
    result$Hedges_g <- as.numeric(coef(model))
    result$CI_lower <- model$ci.lb
    result$CI_upper <- model$ci.ub
    result$p_value <- model$pval
    result$Test_df <- model$ddf[1]
    result$Sigma2_between_studies <- model$sigma2[1]
    result$Sigma2_within_study <- model$sigma2[2]
    result$Boundary_estimate <- any(model$sigma2 < 1e-8)
    result$QE <- model$QE
    result$QE_df <- model$k - model$p
    result$QE_p_value <- model$QEp
    result$Model_V_matches_input <- model$k == nrow(dat) &&
      identical(as.character(model$data$Record_ID), as.character(dat$Record_ID)) &&
      isTRUE(all.equal(as.matrix(model$V), as.matrix(V), check.attributes = FALSE, tolerance = 1e-10))
    if (!is.null(model$opt.res$convergence)) {
      result$Primary_convergence_code <- model$opt.res$convergence
      if (isTRUE(result$Primary_convergence_code != 0)) notes <- c(notes, "Primary optimizer did not converge")
    }
    if (!is.null(check)) {
      if (!is.null(check$opt.res$convergence)) {
        result$Check_convergence_code <- check$opt.res$convergence
        if (isTRUE(result$Check_convergence_code != 0)) notes <- c(notes, "Check optimizer did not converge")
      }
      result$LogLik_difference <- abs(as.numeric(logLik(model) - logLik(check)))
      result$Hedges_g_difference <- abs(as.numeric(coef(model) - coef(check)))
      result$Max_CI_difference <- max(abs(c(model$ci.lb, model$ci.ub) - c(check$ci.lb, check$ci.ub)))
      result$Max_relative_variance_difference <- max(abs(model$sigma2 - check$sigma2) /
        (1 + pmax(abs(model$sigma2), abs(check$sigma2))))
      result$Optimizers_agree <- isTRUE(result$LogLik_difference <= 1e-3 &&
        result$Hedges_g_difference <= 1e-3 && result$Max_CI_difference <= 1e-3 &&
        result$Max_relative_variance_difference <= 1e-3)
    }
    core_ok <- all(is.finite(c(result$Hedges_g, result$CI_lower, result$CI_upper,
      result$p_value, result$Test_df, model$sigma2))) && result$Test_df > 0 &&
      all(model$sigma2 >= 0) && result$CI_lower <= result$Hedges_g &&
      result$Hedges_g <= result$CI_upper
    if (!core_ok) notes <- c(notes, "Core inference incomplete or invalid")
    if (!result$Model_V_matches_input) notes <- c(notes, "Model data/order/V differs from input")
    if (!result$Optimizers_agree) notes <- c(notes, "Optimizer agreement requires review")
    # A valid zero variance alone is not a failure. Passing numerical checks still does not mean that three studies allow precise inference.
    result$Needs_review <- length(notes) > 0
    result$Pool_shown <- core_ok && !result$Needs_review
    result$Status <- if (result$Needs_review) "Review required; estimates provisional" else
      if (result$Boundary_estimate) "Exploratory; numerical checks passed; variance at boundary" else
        "Exploratory; numerical checks passed; few independent studies"
    result$Diagnostics <- paste(unique(notes), collapse = " | ")
    list(data = dat, V = V, model = model, summary = result)
  }, error = function(e) {
    result$Status <- "V or primary model failed; no pooled estimate shown"
    result$Diagnostics <- paste(unique(c(notes, conditionMessage(e))), collapse = " | ")
    list(data = dat, V = V, model = model, summary = result)
  })
}
```

### Table 1 — Heterogeneity in primary analyses

```{r}
#| label: tbl-heterogeneity-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Heterogeneity in category-level and endpoint-level primary analyses."

# N is the number of independent studies and k is the number of effect sizes. Take all statistics directly from existing primary models.
# Category models have study, within-study response and record levels. Single-indicator models have study and record levels.
table1_extract_heterogeneity <- function(result, analysis, response_level) {
  fit <- result$model
  sigma2 <- if (is.null(fit)) rep(NA_real_, if (response_level) 3L else 2L) else fit$sigma2
  stopifnot(length(sigma2) == if (response_level) 3L else 2L)
  tibble::tibble(
    Analysis = analysis, Studies = result$summary$Studies,
    Effect_sizes = if (is.null(fit)) result$summary$Effect_sizes else fit$k,
    Between_study = sigma2[1],
    Within_study_response = if (response_level) sigma2[2] else NA_real_,
    Between_record = sigma2[if (response_level) 3L else 2L],
    Response_level_present = response_level,
    QE = if (is.null(fit)) NA_real_ else fit$QE,
    QE_df = if (is.null(fit)) NA_real_ else fit$k - fit$p,
    QE_p_value = if (is.null(fit)) NA_real_ else fit$QEp
  )
}
table1_category_results <- bind_rows(lapply(names(figure7_models), function(category) {
  table1_extract_heterogeneity(figure7_models[[category]], paste0("Category: ", category), TRUE)
}))
table1_endpoint_models <- list(
  "Chlorophyll-a" = chlorophyll_main,
  "Biofilm mass and growth" = biofilm_mass_main,
  "EPS polysaccharides" = eps_models[["EPS polysaccharides"]],
  "EPS proteins" = eps_models[["EPS proteins"]],
  "Prokaryotic Chao1 richness" = chao1_analysis,
  "Prokaryotic Shannon diversity" = shannon_analysis
)
table1_endpoint_results <- bind_rows(lapply(names(table1_endpoint_models), function(endpoint) {
  table1_extract_heterogeneity(table1_endpoint_models[[endpoint]], paste0("Endpoint: ", endpoint), FALSE)
}))
table1_numeric <- bind_rows(table1_category_results, table1_endpoint_results)

# A dash means that the model has no such random-effect level. Show zero variance as 0 and a missing fit as NA.
# p value is the P value for QE, not for the overall Hedges' g.
table1_format_number <- function(x, digits = 3L) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
}
table1 <- table1_numeric |>
  transmute(
    Analysis,
    `N / k` = paste(Studies, Effect_sizes, sep = " / "),
    `Between-study σ²` = table1_format_number(Between_study),
    `Within-study response σ²` = if_else(Response_level_present,
      table1_format_number(Within_study_response), "—"),
    `Between-record σ²` = table1_format_number(Between_record),
    `QE (df)` = if_else(is.na(QE), "NA",
      paste0(table1_format_number(QE, 2L), " (", QE_df, ")")),
    `p value` = case_when(is.na(QE_p_value) ~ "NA", QE_p_value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
                          TRUE ~ table1_format_number(QE_p_value))
  )
write.csv(table1, "outputs/Table1_Heterogeneity_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE,
          na = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
knitr::kable(table1, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure8-summary-inputs

library(dplyr)

  chlorophyll = "Chlorophyll_a_model_summary.csv", mass = "Biofilm_biomass_growth_model_summary.csv",
  eps = "EPS_model_summary.csv", chao1 = "Prokaryotic_Chao1_model_summary.csv",

)

})
figure8_spec <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Group, ~Response, ~Source, ~Analysis, ~Expected_studies, ~Expected_effects,
  "Biomass and growth", "Chlorophyll-a", "chlorophyll", "All studies", 5L, 19L,
  "Biomass and growth", "Biofilm mass and growth", "mass", "Main: DW + AFDW/AFDM + growth", 6L, 22L,
  "Biochemical composition", "EPS polysaccharides", "eps", "EPS polysaccharides", 5L, 19L,
  "Biochemical composition", "EPS proteins", "eps", "EPS proteins", 5L, 19L,
  "Community diversity", "Prokaryotic Chao1 richness", "chao1", "Prokaryotic Chao1 richness", 3L, 10L,
  "Community diversity", "Prokaryotic Shannon diversity", "shannon", "Prokaryotic Shannon diversity", 3L, 10L
)

    all(is.finite(c(result$Hedges_g, result$CI_lower, result$CI_upper))))
  if ("Pool_shown" %in% names(result)) stopifnot(isTRUE(result$Pool_shown))
  tibble::tibble(Group = spec$Group, Response = spec$Response,

    Source_file = figure8_result_files[[spec$Source]], Source_analysis = result$Analysis)
}))

# Fix the export location in the thesis project so it does not depend on R's working directory. PNGs are 300 dpi.
save_figure8 <- function(draw, stem, height) {
  project_dir <- normalizePath("C:/Users/87236/Desktop/Final essay/Thesis data analysis",
    winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "outputs")
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  png_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".png"))
  pdf_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".pdf"))
  message("Current working directory: ", normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/"),
    "\nOutput directory: ", output_dir)

  grDevices::cairo_pdf(pdf_file,
    width = 6.3, height = height, pointsize = 10, bg = "white")
  tryCatch(draw(), finally = grDevices::dev.off())
  grDevices::png(png_file,
    width = 6.3, height = height, units = "in", res = 300, pointsize = 10,
    bg = "white", type = "cairo")
  tryCatch(draw(), finally = grDevices::dev.off())
  message("Saved PNG: ", png_file, "\nSaved PDF: ", pdf_file)
  invisible(c(PNG = png_file, PDF = pdf_file))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-figure8-pooled-summary
#| fig-width: 6.3
#| fig-height: 4.8
#| fig-cap: "Pooled effects of representative biofilm responses. Each response was modelled separately; studies may overlap across responses. Biofilm mass and growth combines dry weight, AFDM/AFDW and AFDM-based growth rate from grazer-excluded comparisons. Chao1 and Shannon analyses are exploratory, with three independent studies each. Signs indicate numerical changes relative to controls, not improvement or deterioration. All markers have equal size."

# Use six existing primary models in three groups without further pooling across indicators. Use full-precision interval endpoints for the lines.
draw_figure8_data <- function() {
  old <- par(mar = c(1.5, 0.35, 1.9, 0.35), ps = 10, cex = 1,
    family = "sans", bg = "white", xpd = NA)
  on.exit(par(old), add = TRUE)
  plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(-1.3, 11.2), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i",
    axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE, bty = "n")
  title("Representative biofilm responses", cex.main = 1.1, line = 0.4)
  rows <- c(8.3, 7.3, 5.3, 4.3, 2.3, 1.3)
  for (i in c(2L, 3L)) {
    indices <- (2L * i - 1L):(2L * i)
    rect(0.005, min(rows[indices]) - 0.45, 0.998, max(rows[indices]) + 0.45,
      col = "#F1F6F6", border = NA)
  }
  text(0.015, 10.55, "Response", adj = 0, font = 2, cex = 0.9)
  text(0.365, 10.55, "Studies", font = 2, cex = 0.85)
  text(0.455, 10.55, "Effect\nsizes", font = 2, cex = 0.85)
  text(0.995, 10.55, "Hedges' g [95% CI]", adj = 1, font = 2, cex = 0.85)
  segments(0.005, 9.95, 0.998, 9.95, col = "#A8AFB0", lwd = 0.8)
  text(0.015, c(9.2, 6.2, 3.2), unique(figure8_data$Group),
    adj = 0, font = 2, cex = 0.98, col = "#195C60")
  labels <- c("Chlorophyll-a", "Biofilm mass and\ngrowth", "EPS polysaccharides", "EPS proteins",
    "Prokaryotic Chao1\nrichness", "Prokaryotic Shannon\ndiversity")
  ticks <- pretty(range(figure8_data$CI_lower, figure8_data$CI_upper, 0), n = 4)
  limits <- range(ticks)
  xpos <- function(value) 0.56 + 0.23 * (value - limits[1]) / diff(limits)
  segments(xpos(0), 0.7, xpos(0), 8.8, lty = 2, col = "#8A8A8A")
  text(0.015, rows, labels, adj = 0, cex = 0.92)
  text(0.365, rows, figure8_data$Studies, cex = 0.92)
  text(0.455, rows, figure8_data$Effect_sizes, cex = 0.92)
  segments(xpos(figure8_data$CI_lower), rows, xpos(figure8_data$CI_upper), rows,
    col = "#707070", lwd = 1.25)
  points(xpos(figure8_data$yi), rows, pch = 15, cex = 0.85, col = "#287F83")
  text(0.995, rows, sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", figure8_data$yi,
    figure8_data$CI_lower, figure8_data$CI_upper), adj = 1, cex = 0.83)
  axis(1, at = xpos(ticks), labels = format(ticks, trim = TRUE), pos = 0.15,
    tck = -0.015, mgp = c(1, 0.45, 0), cex.axis = 0.85)
  text(0.675, -0.95, "Hedges' g", cex = 0.95)
}
draw_figure8_data()
save_figure8(draw_figure8_data, "Figure8_Representative_response_effects", 4.8)
```

### Figure 9 — Individual effect estimates for selected biofilm functional responses

```{r}
#| label: figure9-data
# 1. Read calculated effect sizes and retain PSII effective quantum yield and LDH activity separately -----------
# Keep yi, vi and individual 95% CIs from the effect-size table. The direction is Treatment − Control.
# Hedges' g already includes the small-sample bias correction. Individual intervals use the normal approximation; do not recalculate them here.
library(dplyr)
library(metafor)

figure9_titles <- c(
  "Effective PSII quantum yield" = "(a) Effective PSII quantum yield",
  "Lactate dehydrogenase activity" = "(b) Lactate dehydrogenase activity"
)
figure9_data <- read.csv("outputs/Effect_size_calculated.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM") |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    # Use the existing common name for S16 LDH activity and S21 LDH. Keep the original names.
    Response_standard = if_else(Study_ID %in% c("S16", "S21") &
      Response_reported %in% c("LDH", "LDH activity"),
      "Lactate dehydrogenase activity", Response_reported)
  ) |>
  filter(Response_standard %in% names(figure9_titles), !Study_ID %in% c("S06", "S18")) |>
  arrange(match(Response_standard, names(figure9_titles)),
    Study_ID, Experiment_ID, Treatment_Arm_ID, Control_Arm_ID, Record_ID) |>
  mutate(
    # Shorten arm prefixes in the plot. Keep full study, experiment, treatment and control IDs in the data.
    Comparison_label = paste0(Study_ID, " | ", sub("^S[0-9]+_", "", Experiment_ID), ": ",
      sub("^S[0-9]+_E[0-9]+_", "", Treatment_Arm_ID), " vs ",
      sub("^S[0-9]+_E[0-9]+_", "", Control_Arm_ID))
  )

figure9_counts <- figure9_data |>
  group_by(Response_standard) |>
  summarise(Studies = n_distinct(Study_ID), Effect_sizes = n(),
    Study_IDs = paste(sort(unique(Study_ID)), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(match(Response_standard, names(figure9_titles)))
print(figure9_counts, n = Inf, width = Inf)
print(select(figure9_data, Response_standard, Study_ID, Experiment_ID,
  Treatment_Arm_ID, Control_Arm_ID, yi, vi, CI_lower, CI_upper), n = Inf, width = Inf)

stopifnot(n_distinct(figure9_data$Response_standard) == 2L,
  !anyNA(figure9_data$Record_ID), !anyDuplicated(figure9_data$Record_ID),
  all(is.finite(figure9_data$yi)),
  all(is.finite(figure9_data$vi) & figure9_data$vi > 0),
  all(is.finite(figure9_data$CI_lower)), all(is.finite(figure9_data$CI_upper)))
if (any(figure9_counts$Studies != 2L) ||
    any(figure9_counts$Effect_sizes != c(4L, 8L))) {
  warning("The current data differ from the expected 2 studies per response and 4/8 effect sizes. See figure9_counts for the actual counts and study IDs.")
}

figure9_width <- 11.5
figure9_height <- 10.8
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-figure9-functional-responses
#| fig-width: 11.5
#| fig-height: 10.8
#| fig-align: center

# 2. Show individual comparisons in two panels without fitting models or calculating cross-study pooled statistics --------
# Keep comparisons from the same study together. Use light backgrounds to distinguish studies and keep square sizes equal.
draw_figure9 <- function() {
  # Increase all text by 25% and keep the relative sizes of titles, body text, axes and footnotes.
  font_scale <- 1.25
  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(old_par), add = TRUE)
  panel_heights <- vapply(names(figure9_titles), function(response) {
    sum(figure9_data$Response_standard == response) + 5
  }, numeric(1))
  layout(matrix(1:2, ncol = 1), heights = panel_heights)
  par(oma = c(3.5, 0, 3.1, 0), mar = c(4.3, 1.6, 3.1, 1.6),
    family = "sans", ps = 12, bg = "white", xpd = NA)

  for (response in names(figure9_titles)) {
    dat <- filter(figure9_data, Response_standard == response)
    study_index <- match(dat$Study_ID, unique(dat$Study_ID))
    rows <- rev(seq_len(nrow(dat))) + max(study_index) - study_index
    # Each panel's x-axis covers all intervals and 0. alim sets the effect-size range; xlim also leaves space for the text columns on both sides.
    axis_ticks <- pretty(range(dat$CI_lower, dat$CI_upper, 0), n = 6)
    axis_limits <- range(axis_ticks)
    axis_span <- diff(axis_limits)
    plot_limits <- axis_limits + c(-1.1, 0.55) * axis_span
    label_x <- plot_limits[1] + 0.03 * axis_span
    value_x <- plot_limits[2] - 0.03 * axis_span

    metafor::forest(dat$yi, ci.lb = dat$CI_lower, ci.ub = dat$CI_upper,
      slab = dat$Comparison_label, rows = rows, ylim = c(0, max(rows) + 2.5),
      xlim = plot_limits, alim = axis_limits, at = axis_ticks,
      textpos = c(label_x, value_x), annotate = TRUE, xlab = "Hedges' g", refline = 0,
      header = c("Study / treatment vs control", "Hedges' g [95% CI]"),
      pch = 15, psize = 1, col = "#287F83", colci = "#4D4D4D",
      shade = study_index %% 2 == 0, colshade = "#F1F6F6",
      cex = 0.9 * font_scale, cex.axis = 0.85 * font_scale,
      cex.lab = 0.95 * font_scale, digits = 2L)
    title(figure9_titles[[response]], cex.main = 1.1 * font_scale)
  }
  mtext("Individual effect estimates for selected biofilm functional responses",
    side = 3, outer = TRUE, line = 0.9, font = 2, cex = 1.05 * font_scale)
  mtext(c(
    "Squares and lines represent individual Hedges' g estimates and 95% confidence intervals.",
    "Comparisons within studies may share controls; signs indicate numerical changes relative to controls."
  ), side = 1, outer = TRUE, line = c(0.8, 1.9), cex = 0.75 * font_scale)
}

draw_figure9()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure9-export
# 3. Export the same two-panel figure: vector PDF and 600 dpi PNG ------------------
dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)
grDevices::cairo_pdf("outputs/Figure9_Functional_responses.pdf",
  width = figure9_width, height = figure9_height)
tryCatch(draw_figure9(), finally = grDevices::dev.off())

grDevices::png("outputs/Figure9_Functional_responses.png",
  width = figure9_width, height = figure9_height, units = "in", res = 600, type = "cairo")
tryCatch(draw_figure9(), finally = grDevices::dev.off())
```
